name: Disenchant: Looter's Cap can be disenchanted (COA-9626)
contract: The Looter's Cap 2060043 is uncommon item level 18 cloth armour and uses disenchant bracket 2 like stock uncommon item level 18 armour. A character with Enchanting 300 casting Disenchant 13262 on it gets a disenchant loot window with at least one item, and closing it consumes the cap.

steps.label: the disenchant loot window holds materials
closing the loot window consumes the cap
